name: MusicHaptics
tagline: 原生音乐触感与四种通用模式，让音乐化作触感。
description: MusicHaptics 为越狱 iPhone 提供音乐触感。默认使用 Apple 原生数据，可选择全部混音或仅人声。
通用模式根据音频变化生成触感，提供连续能量、节奏震动、Sound2Hap 实时适配和仿苹果四种选择；无需歌曲编号，也无需安装 Lunora。
支持弱、中、强三档强度，可在设置或控制中心随时开关。
notice: 通用模式需要安装并启用 Banana Audio Service，包管理器会自动安装此依赖。它处理系统混音，其他声音可能混入，不支持仅人声；Sound2Hap 实时适配和仿苹果均为独立实现。原生模式首次加载歌曲触感需联网，部分歌曲没有触感或人声轨道，Shazam 免费试听及部分免费内容可能不支持。若原生触感下载未响应，可先在 Shazam 或控制中心启动一次“音乐识别”，结束后返回并重试。原生模式请使用正常播放速度并关闭杜比全景声；如已开启系统自带音乐触感，请先关闭以免重复反馈。iOS 18 及以上及不同音频输出路线仍需验证。
features: Apple 原生数据：全部混音与仅人声
通用模式：连续能量、节奏震动、Sound2Hap 实时适配、仿苹果
通用模式无需歌曲编号，直接使用独立 Banana Audio Service
控制中心快捷开关，与设置同步
触感样本、播放状态与原生歌曲重试入口
English、简体中文、繁體中文设置及 Discord、QQ 反馈入口
compatibility: 最低 iOS 15，无最高版本限制
原生模式已有 iOS 15、16、17 用户实测
通用模式已有 iPhone 13 Pro Max / iOS 17.3.1 RootHide 用户实测
iOS 18 及以上、其他设备及音频输出路线仍需验证
需要支持触感反馈的越狱 iPhone
Rootless / RootHide；每包包含 arm64 / arm64e
依赖 Banana Audio Service 1.0.2+、PreferenceLoader 和 CCSupport
usage: 安装匹配越狱环境的版本及依赖，重新载入 SpringBoard，再打开“设置 → 音乐触感”。
在“高级”中选择数据来源；默认 Apple 原生数据，可选择全部混音或仅人声。
选择“使用通用模式”后，在“震动模式”中选择连续能量、节奏震动、Sound2Hap 实时适配或仿苹果。
使用通用模式时，确认 Banana Audio Service 已启用，再播放音频。服务首次安装及旧版本迁移请按该依赖包说明操作。
设置弱、中、强三档强度，或点击“播放样本”体验触感；在控制中心添加“音乐触感”可快速开关。
原生歌曲无反馈时查看播放状态；若下载服务未响应，先启动并结束一次“音乐识别”，再重试当前歌曲。

changes: 新增通用模式，提供连续能量、节奏震动、Sound2Hap 实时适配和仿苹果四种触感。
通用模式使用独立 Banana Audio Service，无需安装 Lunora。
完善三语言设置、模式切换及音频暂停或中断时的停震处理。
改善 iOS 16 的歌曲触感下载兼容性。
新增下载未响应时的操作提示：先启动一次 Shazam 或控制中心“音乐识别”，再重试歌曲。
iOS 15、16、17 已有用户实测；iOS 18 及以上兼容性仍待验证。
修复 iOS 15 切换控制中心开关或调整触感强度时意外重新载入桌面的问题。
修复 iOS 15 歌曲触感下载，并改善 Apple Music 账号地区与系统地区不同时的歌曲匹配。
iOS 15 已完成 Apple Music 下载与播放实测，iOS 17 有此前版本的成功记录；iOS 16 待测，iOS 18 及以上尚未完成兼容验证。
首次发布音乐触感反馈，支持全部混音与仅人声模式。
提供弱、中、强三档强度及控制中心快捷开关。
提供三语言设置、触感样本及 Discord、QQ 反馈入口。

en.name: MusicHaptics
en.tagline: Native music haptics and four Universal modes turn music into touch.
description: MusicHaptics brings music haptic feedback to jailbroken iPhones. Apple native data is the default, with Full Mix and Vocals Only options.

Universal mode generates haptics from audio changes, with Continuous Energy, Rhythmic Vibrating Alert, Sound2Hap adaptation and Apple-inspired options. No song identifier or Lunora installation is required.
Choose Weak, Medium or Strong intensity and toggle haptics from Settings or Control Center.
en.notice: Universal mode requires Banana Audio Service to be installed and enabled; your package manager installs this dependency automatically. It uses the system audio mix, so other sounds may be included, and vocals-only output is unavailable. Sound2Hap adaptation and Apple-inspired modes are independent implementations. Native mode needs an internet connection to load a song’s haptics for the first time. Some songs have no haptic or vocal track; Shazam previews and some free content may be unsupported. If native downloads do not respond, start music recognition once in Shazam or Control Center, end recognition, then retry. Use normal playback speed with Dolby Atmos off for native mode. Disable Apple’s built-in Music Haptics to avoid duplicate feedback. iOS 18 and later and different audio routes remain unverified.
features: Apple native data with Full Mix and Vocals Only
Universal modes: Continuous Energy, Rhythmic Vibrating Alert, Sound2Hap adaptation and Apple-inspired
Universal mode uses standalone Banana Audio Service without song identifiers
Control Center toggle synchronized with Settings
Haptic sample, playback status and native song retry
English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese, with Discord and QQ feedback links
compatibility: Requires iOS 15 or later; no upper version limit
Native mode has user testing on iOS 15, 16 and 17
Universal mode has user testing on iPhone 13 Pro Max / iOS 17.3.1 RootHide
iOS 18 and later, other devices and audio routes remain unverified
Requires a jailbroken iPhone with haptic support
Rootless / RootHide; both packages include arm64 / arm64e
Requires Banana Audio Service 1.0.2+, PreferenceLoader and CCSupport
usage: Install the package matching your jailbreak environment and its dependencies, respring, then open Settings → Music Haptics.
Choose the data source in Advanced. Apple native data is the default, with Full Mix and Vocals Only options.
Select Universal mode to choose Continuous Energy, Rhythmic Vibrating Alert, Sound2Hap adaptation or Apple-inspired haptics.
For Universal mode, enable Banana Audio Service and play audio. Follow that dependency’s guidance for first installation and migration.
Select Weak, Medium or Strong intensity, or use Play Sample. Add Music Haptics to Control Center for quick toggling.
For native songs without feedback, check Playback Status. If downloads do not respond, start and end Music Recognition once, then retry the current song.

changes: Add Universal mode with Continuous Energy, Rhythmic Vibrating Alert, Sound2Hap adaptation and Apple-inspired haptics.
Universal mode uses the standalone Banana Audio Service; Lunora is no longer required.
Improve trilingual settings, mode switching, and stopping haptics when audio pauses or becomes unavailable.
Improve song haptic download compatibility on iOS 16.
Add guidance for unresponsive downloads: start music recognition once in Shazam or Control Center, then retry the song.
User-tested on iOS 15, 16 and 17; compatibility with iOS 18 and later remains unverified.
Fix unexpected resprings when toggling Control Center or changing haptic intensity on iOS 15.
Fix song haptic downloads on iOS 15 and improve matching when the Apple Music account region differs from the device region.
Apple Music download and playback were tested on iOS 15, with earlier success on iOS 17; iOS 16 awaits testing, and iOS 18 or later compatibility remains unverified.
First release of music haptic feedback with Full Mix and Vocals Only modes.
Includes Weak, Medium, and Strong intensity levels and a Control Center toggle.
Includes trilingual settings, a haptic sample, and Discord and QQ feedback links.
